prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Nyxara Vale. Character visual motifs: angular thief wearing articulated matte-black lacquer strips that cast sharp, oversized silhouettes on the ground; no shadow clones.
TOP LEFT: Blind Side. Ability concept: Nyxara gains a small first-hit bonus when striking from outside the target's *forward* vision cone, once / target / 7 s. Visible directional marker informs defenders when exposed.
TOP RIGHT: Shadow Pin. Ability concept: projects a dark triangular plane from a chosen wall or her own location for 4 s. It blocks **line of sight for basic attack acquisition**, not projectiles, and is transparent to all after a unit steps through.
BOTTOM LEFT: Light Theft. Ability concept: steals illumination from one existing Shadow Pin for 2 s, collapsing that plane into a mobile veil around Nyxara. She remains targetable at close range and leaves bright footsteps; while veiled, her next attack briefly reduces the victim's turn speed.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Total Eclipse, Partial Truth. Ability concept: places three visible *false target silhouettes* along an 80-GU arc. They do not attack, teleport, or explode; enemy targeting systems briefly need fresh line-of-sight confirmation when Nyxara crosses the arc. Her next hit against an isolated foe deals bonus damage, capped.
